alt.en: A large gray GPU package, a die ringed by four memory stacks, sits at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line carrying one packet runs to it from a crate with a teal label on the left, and a dotted light-gray line runs from it to a standing page of writing on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央是一块大型灰色 GPU 封装，核心芯片四周环绕四个内存堆栈。左侧带青色标签的货箱经一条载有数据包的橙色虚线连到 GPU，GPU 再以浅灰色点线连到右侧一页竖立的文件。

caption.en: Illustration: A GPU package stands for the experimental GPU integration NVIDIA describes for Agent Substrate, with a crate for a saved session snapshot on one side and a document for the runtime description on the other. It does not depict a tested deployment or NVIDIA's hardware, and it does not show that snapshots restore onto GPUs as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：GPU 封装代表 NVIDIA 为 Agent Substrate 描述的实验性 GPU 集成，一侧的货箱代表保存的会话快照，另一侧的文件代表运行时说明。图中并非经过测试的部署，也不是 NVIDIA 的硬件，不能说明快照能如其所述恢复到 GPU 上。
